PhysicalPropertyTableImport.Notes: A is instantaneous thermal expansion; B is mean expansion from 20 degC. A/B source coefficients multiplied by 1E-6 into 1/degC. C is linear expansion in mm/m from 20 degC, preserved separately, not specific heat. Source Part 2 introduction (PDF 1205) declares +/-10% uncertainty. Missing source cells remain absent. Verify source applicability and associations; no extrapolation is supplied.
PhysicalPropertyTableImport.SourceNotes: Material identities follow explicit source compositions/UNS. Copper UNS family patterns require manual association; no individual UNS is invented. Precipitation-hardened steel Conditions 1075/1150 require manual condition review. Titanium UNS keys use explicit Table TM-5 grade/UNS pairs (PDF 1244).
PhysicalPropertyTableImport.SourceColumns: Temperature=degC; A/B=1/degC; sourceA/B=1E-6/degC; C=mm/m; referenceTemperature=20 degC.
